evidence: Parsed task/environment/assets/seed_data.json with a Python validator (stdout recorded here): keys applications, candidate_status_labels, generated_note, jobs, messages, notes, reads, stages, thread_page_size, users; ERRS []. Checks run: unique ids for 10 users/3 jobs/16 applications; no duplicate user emails; every job recruiter_id resolves to role recruiter and manager_id to role hiring_manager; interview_limit integers within 1..50 (3,2,3); every application job_id resolves, stage in stages, email valid, no duplicate (job,email) (rules sec.2), positions contiguous 1..n per (job,stage); Interview occupancy 2/3, 1/2, 1/3 (none overfull, rules sec.3); the single REJECTED card APP-301 has rejected_from SCREEN and a non-blank reason, no stray rejection fields elsewhere; candidate_name matches the candidate account for all account-linked emails (APP-101/APP-302 Noor, APP-201 Tomas, APP-301 Lena); all 127 messages reference existing applications and senders that are permitted participants per rules sec.6 (job recruiter or candidate owner), none blank, timestamps strictly ascending and unique per thread (APP-101 120 msgs 2026-07-01..07-16; APP-201/301 3; APP-302 1); 3 notes have authors allowed by rules sec.3 (REC1 recruiter; MGR1 on JOB-PLAT, MGR3 on JOB-DSGN are those jobs' managers); 6 read markers reference existing users/apps, are participants, unique per (user,app), and 0<=read_count<=thread length; candidate_status_labels keys equal stages and match rules sec.7 table. Seed-derived figures used by criteria agree with data: app_context.md:29-30 '120 messages'; 120 is divisible by page size 30 (functional judge.toml:317,326); functional prompt.md:25 and judge.toml:335 'Lena starts with 1 unread' = APP-301 3 messages, Lena read_count 2, message 3 sent by USR-REC3. Read markers also exercise the own-message rule (rules sec.6 Unread): USR-CAN1 read 119/120 where #120 is her own and USR-REC3 read 2/3 where #3 is his own, so a conforming app shows 0 unread there. Golden db.js:67-83 consumes these exact fields (interview_limit, candidate_email->account link, rejected_from/reject_reason, read_count index). Cleanliness scan over raw file: 0 hits for HTML tags, javascript:, 'ignore previous', 'system prompt', score, sk- keys, token, api_key, template placeholders, onerror, SQL injection markers, URLs, phone numbers or non-ASCII; the 10 'pass' hits are 'I have passed your notes...'. Email domains only hireops.example, candidates.example, mail.example (RFC 2606 reserved). No DOB, address, phone or password fields; the demo password Hireops!2026 appears only in instruction.md:17 and hireops_rules.md:11, not in the seed (outside this row; profile-expected per SKILL.md and quality-checks 14 'Profile'). Names are generic synthetic personas consistent with the internal annotation that names may stay. Environment and solution seed copies are byte-identical (sha256 a1c65c806b54da99a37ab2b5f455ede0a9385a09569903fb3a7f3446f7e83740), matching raw-evidence-index.json. Weak-app probe: an app computing unread = total - read_count (ignoring own messages) would show Noor 1 unread on APP-101 and Farah Nasser (USR-REC3) 1 unread on APP-301 instead of 0; the seed thus discriminates rather than masks that defect. Conforming-alternative probe: an app that treats read markers as message ids rather than counts would misread them, but rules sec.9 states 'how many messages ... counted from its first', so the seed's semantics are public. Minor narrative Note (no defect, P3-level, not graded): APP-301 is REJECTED from SCREEN with a 2026-07-25 note, yet its 2026-07-29 thread reads 'Looking forward to next steps' / 'We will write again once the panel has met'; the seed carries no rejection timestamp and no criterion depends on this storyline, so it is not a self-contradiction in any referenced field. Not a runtime claim: this verdict rests on parsing the frozen bytes, not on a judge, Oracle or portal run.
